'''Salerodrex''' were the dominant predators in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]]. They had an excellent hearing and could smell [[Blood/Legends|blood]] from many [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away. Their sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] could cut in half a [[Human/Legends|human]] body with ease.<ref name="SoF" />
